Karen A. Gould, Ph.D., M.Ed., Interim Dean Graduate Studies
UNMC educational programs consistently rank among the highest in the nation, and our researchers are in the forefront of fields such as immunology, cancer, genomics, drug development and delivery, as well infectious, neurodegenerative, and cardiovascular diseases. Graduate Studies is at the very heart of UNMC, and many of our students work in the labs, clinics, and communities where this groundbreaking research takes place.
As part of the University of Nebraska Graduate College, UNMC Graduate Studies is under the leadership of Dr. Karen Gould, Interim Dean of Graduate Studies. It is our mission to provide, promote and enhance the highest quality graduate education in health science at UNMC.
